move: curtains part slowly, frame settles, serif title rises, curtains shut
how: A desaturated full-frame video creeps from scale 1.25 to 1.05 linearly across the whole loop behind a vignette. Two black curtain halves scaleX 1→0 from the outer edges with expo.inOut over 0.375D; a thin frame settles in from scale 1.08 with power2.out. The eyebrow tightens from letter-spacing 1.4em with power3.out, the two serif title lines rise out of overflow masks (yPercent 105→0 expo.out, stagger 0.18), a centre rule draws scaleX with expo.out, then the date and brand fade in. At 0.84D the title lines exit upward with power3.in, everything else fades, and the curtains sweep shut with expo.in to close the loop.
adapt: Swap the video, eyebrow, title lines, date and brand strings and the colour scheme; keep the 1.5s expo.inOut curtain, the letter-spacing eyebrow and the 1.2s title rise for the slow-build feel.
port: mount(el, shot) builds video, .frame, type blocks and two .curtain elements, waiting on loadeddata; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the video-scrub tween (onUpdate sets currentTime) and offsets as fractions of D (curtains 0.1/4, title 1.35/4, close 3.55/4). Scope selectors to el.
caveats: animates letterSpacing, which relayouts text each frame
filter saturate/contrast/brightness on full-frame video is a render cost
video scrub relies on loaded media
